snippet.title: PlayStation - The Deep - Ushinawareta Shinkai (1996) - [Intro]
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
The Deep: Ushinawareta Shinkai is an Adventure game, developed by Marionette and published by Acclaim, which was released in Japan in 1996.
